assessment: The Analysis answers the frozen Methodological question without exceeding the Synthesis. It treats raw error increase as an investigation signal rather than a sufficient retraining condition, requires persistent post-correction mismatch plus evidence of changed process/predictive conditions, keeps non-model causes as a separate diagnostic branch required by the frozen scope, and classifies parameter-changing moving-window/recursive/ensemble approaches on the model-update side under this Investigation's explicit definition. It does not invent universal thresholds, sample sizes, or a complete diagnostic algorithm, and requires testing/monitoring of a retrained candidate. No material bypass or unsupported judgment was identified.
